captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Little kid from Rosario, never needed the spotlight's glare,

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Left the club that made me, still stayed right where the magic's there.

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Fans in Miami singing like it's a street in Barcelona's rain,

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: You chase the highlight reel, I chase the trophy, that's the game.

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Your Real Madrid chapter's full of headlines, I respect the grind,

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: But I rolled up in Qatar and lifted what your résumé left behind.

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: You dance for the cameras, I dance for the crowd and the crew,

captions.speaker: fighter1
captions.text: Ball at my feet, the whole world leaning forward, waiting on you.

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: You talk about the crowd, but the crowd's been chanting my name for years,

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Cristiano, Portugal, Euro champion, the trophy's the one that cheers.

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: You're the Argentine poet with the perfect touch and calm,

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: But I'm the one who scores through pressure, I bring the storm.

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Champions League, five of them, don't need to explain the stats,

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Real Madrid's house is still my house, every fan has the receipts.

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Al Nassr, Saudi, yeah, I went where the new road led,

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: You kept your lap of honor, I'm still the one who never bled.

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: Stay humble, little man, the GOAT is a title earned in the fight,

captions.speaker: fighter2
captions.text: And I've got the scars and the medals and the proof you'd call alright.
